title: Certifiable Semantic Agreement Among LLM Agents: What the Admissibility Instrument Decides
abstract: arXiv:2606.07316v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a committee of LLM agents reach agreement that is certifiable at the level of meaning, not only at the level of a label? We build a protocol to find out. H-CSC emits one of three typed outcomes per round -- semantic commit, verdict commit, or typed abort -- under a common 2f+1 distinct-signer certificate, and we use it to measure what such agreement costs and buys. The answer is conditional, and the condition is not the protocol. We prove a containment lemma: whenever the semantic core is large enough to make the committed verdict deterministically valid, the verdict margin already exceeds f, so at matched deterministic guarantees no coverage separation from certificate-wrapped majority is possible. Measurement agrees: the two rules commit the identical task set. What matters instead is the admissibility instrument. translated_title: 可认证的LLM智能体间语义一致性：可采纳性工具决定了什么
translated_abstract: 摘要：一组LLM智能体能否达成不仅在标签层面、而且在意义层面可认证的一致性？我们构建了一个协议来探究这一问题。H-CSC在每轮中根据一个共同的2f+1个不同签名者的证书，输出三种类型的结果之一——语义提交、裁决提交或类型中止，我们利用它来衡量这种一致性所需的代价和带来的收益。答案是条件性的，而条件并非协议本身。我们证明了一个包含引理：只要语义核心足够大，使得提交的裁决具有确定性有效性，那么裁决余量就已经超过f，因此在匹配的确定性保证下，与证书包装的多数投票相比，覆盖率上不可能存在分离。测量结果与此一致：两种规则提交了相同的任务集。真正起作用的而是可采纳性工具。针对那些保留裁决且仅破坏推理过程的对手，一个442 MB的微调编码器重新...
tldr: 本文通过构建H-CSC协议，证明在相同确定性保证下，LLM智能体委员会的语义可认证一致性与多数投票无覆盖率差异，其关键决定因素是“可采纳性工具”而非协议本身。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the H-CSC protocol to show that, under matched deterministic guarantees, semantic certifiable agreement among LLM agents offers no coverage separation from majority voting, with the admissibility instrument being the decisive factor rather than the protocol.
